messages:
Maya R: Wow, that all-hands hit different today — big energy! :raised_hands:
Tom H: Agreed. that roadmap animation was oddly soothing 😂
Jessie: Also applause for the surprise donut shoutout. needed that. :doughnut: :clap:
Carlos: I may have heroically rescued the remaining blueberry muffins. no regrets. :blue_heart:
Lina: GIF: [tiny cheering corgi] :heart_eyes:
all-hands-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/1763954821 (auto-captioning enabled)
Evan: Can we get a poll next time for Best All-Hands Snack? I nominate muffins. :ballot_box_with_ballot:
Sam K: +1 for muffins, -1 for soggy bagels from last holiday party :grimacing:
Priya N: Shoutout to infra — that demo stayed online the whole time!! :trophy:
Aisha: Who else is stealing the emoji cloud as their desktop background? guilty 🙋‍♀️
Tom H: @Aisha post it in #random pls, I will wallpaper my laptop with it :joy:
Jessie: Also, if anyone has notes on the new holiday day policy, drop them here. non-official question but curious :)
Carlos: tiny poll result in 30s... my pockets are full of muffin crumbs as evidence :sweat_smile:
Lina: Love the new format — shorter updates + Q&A was tight. less death-by-slides. :ok_hand:
Evan: Recording cliffnotes: 1) roadmap teased 2) donuts existed 3) infra good 4) snacks safe
Sam K: If we do a virtual cheers next time, I demand a toast with ~kombucha~ :sunglasses:
Priya N: Congrats to the new IC promotion too!! :confetti_ball: :party_parrot:
Aisha: Meme: [office cat looking unimpressed] caption: "When someone says 'we'll circle back'" :rofl:
Maya R: Love the energy. thanks everyone for chiming in — quick followup: recording + slides linked above for anyone who wants the tl;dr
Tom H: :clap::clap::clap:
Carlos: good night teams, see you at snack time tomorrow 👋
